SELECT r.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifj_task_concurrency_resource refs WHERE refs.resource_id=r.id) AS reference_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifj_task_concurrency_resource binding JOIN ifj_instance inst ON inst.target_id=binding.task_id WHERE binding.resource_id=r.id AND inst.target_type='TASK' AND inst.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'WAITING_EVENT')) AS active_instance_count FROM ifj_concurrency_resource r
WHERE r.id IN #{id}
WHERE 1 = 0
ORDER BY r.id

SELECT definition.plugin_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS active_instance_count FROM ifj_instance inst JOIN ifj_task_definition definition ON definition.id=inst.task_definition_id WHERE inst.target_type='TASK' AND inst.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'WAITING_EVENT') GROUP BY definition.plugin_type ORDER BY definition.plugin_type
